description_en: Queries the maximum bandwidth of an acceleration area
description_zh: 调用GetIpsetsBandwidthLimit接口获取加速区域带宽阈值
kebab_example: aliyun ga get-ipsets-bandwidth-limit --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetIpsetsBandwidthLimit

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance to be queried
parameters.help_zh: 待查询加速区域带宽分配限制信息的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

schema.description_en: The response parameters of the operation

BandwidthAllocationType.description_en:
The type of the bandwidth that is allocated.

ShareBandwidth: shared bandwidth.
ExclusiveBandwidth: dedicated bandwidth
BandwidthAllocationType.description_zh:
带宽分配类型。

ShareBandwidth：共享带宽。

ExclusiveBandwidth：独享带宽

BandwidthLimit.description_en: The maximum bandwidth of the acceleration area. Unit: Mbit/s
BandwidthLimit.description_zh: 加速区域的带宽峰值限额。单位为Mbps
